policy: Only public iOS/iPadOS releases are eligible. Beta, RC, and RC2 rows are excluded.
A blank stable row on The Apple Wiki Kernel page is not filled from its neighboring RC by assumption.
When The Apple Wiki stable row is blank, an exact stable-endpoint firmware diff may supply the kernel tuple.
iPhone18,5 support is additionally checked against the exact firmware build list; generic 23D127 is not treated as the iPhone 17e launch build.
